{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace Contract

inductive Vertex where
  | v (i : Nat)

inductive Edge where
  | e (u : Vertex) (v : Vertex) (cost : Int)

inductive Dist where
  | zero
  | finite (c : Int)
  | negInf
  | null

structure Graph where
  n : Nat
  source : Vertex
  edges : List Edge

def valid (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ g.n ∧ g.n ≤ 10 ∧
  (match g.source with | Vertex.v i => i < g.n end) ∧
  (g.edges.filter (fun e => match e with
    | Edge.e u v c => (match u with | Vertex.v i => i < g.n end) ∧
                       (match v with | Vertex.v j => j < g.n end) ∧
                       (-6 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ 9)
    end)).length = g.edges.length

def solve (g : Graph) : List Dist :=
  List.replicate g.n Dist.null

theorem thm_O1 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) :
  (solve g).length = g.n := by sorry

theorem thm_O2 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) :

theorem thm_O3 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (v : Vertex) :

  (match v with | Vertex.v i => i < g.n end) := by sorry

theorem thm_O4 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (v : Vertex) :

  (match v with | Vertex.v i => (solve g).getD i Dist.null end) = Dist.finite 0 →
  (match v with | Vertex.v i => i < g.n end) := by sorry

theorem thm_O6 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) :
  (solve g).length = g.n := by sorry

theorem thm_O7 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (i : Nat) :
  i < g.n →
  (match g.source with | Vertex.v s => s < g.n end) →
  (match Vertex.v i with | Vertex.v i => i < g.n end) →
  (match Vertex.v i with | Vertex.v i => (solve g).getD i Dist.null end) = (solve g).getD i Dist.null := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (g : Graph), valid g ∧ (solve g).length = g.n ∧
  ∃ (g2 : Graph), valid g2 ∧ (solve g2).length = g2.n := by sorry

end Contract",
